title: Regularity-Aware Stochastic MGDA with Adaptive Per-Iterate Conflict-Avoidant Update
abstract: arXiv:2607.15412v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-objective learning (MOL) aims to optimize multiple objectives simultaneously. The multi-gradient descent algorithm (MGDA) constructs a common descent or conflict-avoidant (CA) direction by solving a gradient-aggregation subproblem. In stochastic settings, the vanilla stochastic MGDA method, SMG, replaces full-batch gradients with mini-batch estimates, causing bias in the resulting CA direction. Existing analyses control this error using continuity of the CA-direction mapping, but do not distinguish how its sensitivity varies with the geometry of the MGDA subproblem. Motivated by this limitation, we show that the MGDA direction map is Lipschitz continuous under reduced nondegeneracy, whereas its general \(1/2\)-H\"older exponent on bounded sets is sharp. translated_title: 正则性感知的随机MGDA方法：自适应逐迭代避冲突更新
translated_abstract: 多目标学习（MOL）旨在同时优化多个目标。多梯度下降算法（MGDA）通过求解梯度聚合子问题来构造公共下降方向或避冲突（CA）方向。在随机设定下，原始的随机MGDA方法（SMG）用小批量梯度估计替代全批量梯度，导致所得的CA方向产生偏差。现有分析利用CA方向映射的连续性来控制这一误差，但未能区分其敏感度如何随MGDA子问题的几何结构而变化。受此局限的启发，我们证明在较弱非退化条件下MGDA方向映射是Lipschitz连续的，而其在有界集上一般的1/2-Hölder指数是紧的（不可改进的）。这一几何特性启发了多目标正则性感知方法，该方法在正则情形下保留自适应MGDA聚合，并切换到固定权重的线性……
tldr: 该论文刻画了MGDA方向映射的几何正则性（弱非退化条件下Lipschitz连续、一般情形下紧的1/2-Hölder指数），并据此提出正则性感知的MoRe方法，在正则情形采用自适应MGDA聚合、在退化情形切换为固定权重更新，从而改进随机多目标优化的避冲突方向估计。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the geometric regularity of the MGDA direction map (Lipschitz continuity under reduced nondegeneracy and a sharp 1/2-Hölder exponent in general) and proposes the regularity-aware MoRe method, which retains adaptive MGDA aggregation in regular regimes and switches to fixed-weight updates to improve conflict-avoidant direction estimation in stochastic multi-objective optimization.
